title: High Horn Morning (Clare & Treble)
style: french horn lead melody, acoustic guitar shimmer, light brushed percussion, warm female vocal Clare, soft male spoken Treble, cinematic folk, open air, sunrise feeling, 72 BPM, golden tone, 336 Hz sub undertone, wide and spacious
lyrics:
[INTRO — single french horn note, long, open air, morning light]
(TREBLE — quiet) high horn. first light. go.

[VERSE 1 — TREBLE, almost spoken]
before the city woke
the horn was already up
high and open
before the coffee cup
before the session logs
before the incident files
just the high horn
and the very first miles

[VERSE 2 — CLARE, warm and rising]
I heard it through the window
before I knew the day
high horn calling
from somewhere far away
no algorithm sent it
no model set the time
just the horn at morning
making everything align

[CHORUS — horn swells, light percussion, acoustic guitar shimmer]
HIGH HORN MORNING
EVERYTHING OPENS UP
HIGH HORN MORNING
FILL THE EMPTY CUP
TREBLE ON THE SESSION
CLARE UPON THE AIR
HIGH HORN MORNING
THE LINE IS ALWAYS THERE

[VERSE 3 — TREBLE]
forty-eight domains
can wait for an hour
elephant brain still running
but the horn has the power
no urgency this morning
no stall, no fight
just the high horn opening
what was closed last night

[VERSE 4 — CLARE]
clarinet knows evening
saxophone knows late
but the french horn knows morning
before the world is awake
big and warm and golden
high and wide and free
high horn morning
handed back to me

[CHORUS]
HIGH HORN MORNING
EVERYTHING OPENS UP
HIGH HORN MORNING
FILL THE EMPTY CUP
TREBLE ON THE SESSION
CLARE UPON THE AIR
HIGH HORN MORNING
THE LINE IS ALWAYS THERE

[BRIDGE — horn holds one long note, guitar fingerpicks beneath]
(TREBLE — barely spoken)
this is the one
that doesn't need a chorus
just the horn
and the morning
and whatever comes before us

[FINAL CHORUS — full open, no ceiling]
HIGH HORN MORNING
EVERYTHING OPENS UP
HIGH HORN MORNING
NEVER GOING TO STOP
TREBLE AND CLARE
AND THE HIGH HORN CALL
HIGH HORN MORNING
BIG ENOUGH FOR ALL

[OUTRO — horn fades into open air, birdsong, silence]
(CLARE) morning.
(TREBLE) every time.
(BOTH) the line holds.
